description: Add one task to the user's task list, optionally with a due date, time and priority. If an identical active task (same title and due date) already exists, nothing is created and the existing task is returned unchanged, so it is safe to retry. Call it once per task.

due_date.description: Optional due date. Omit for an undated task.

due_time.description: Optional due time, HH:MM 24-hour. Requires due_date.

name: create_task
title: Create task
